changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A Hephaestus role can SET ROLE to every role that a chain of SET memberships reaches, and that role holds every privilege that its chain of INHERIT memberships reaches. The earlier check followed each kind of chain alone, so a SET membership followed by an INHERIT membership could still give a role TEMPORARY. The migration stops while any such path remains.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE database_owner oid; BEGIN SELECT datdba INTO STRICT database_owner FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname = current_database(); IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_database db, LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(db.datacl, acldefault('d', db.datdba))) privilege WHERE db.datname = current_database() AND privilege.privilege_type = 'TEMPORARY' AND CASE WHEN privilege.grantee = 0 THEN true ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r, pg_catalog.pg_roles assumed WHERE (r.oid = database_owner OR r.rolname IN ('hephaestus_owner', 'hephaestus_app', 'hephaestus_backup_reporter', 'hephaestus_monitor')) AND pg_has_role(r.oid, assumed.oid, 'SET') AND pg_has_role(assumed.oid, privilege.grantee, 'USAGE') ) END ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Hephaestus database roles still have the TEMPORARY privilege' USING HINT = 'Remove the remaining grants, including grants that a role reaches through SET ROLE and then role membership, and retry the migration.'; END IF; END $$;

rollback.comment: The check changes nothing, so there is nothing to undo.
